column1: # What a table's own printed summary states, and how to recompute it from its rows.
# The summary is printed outside the grid (MAE A1's last page); totals and subtotals
# printed as rows of the grid are checked from `columns.tsv` (`sum`) without a line here.
# table: the table key. label: a regular expression on the printed label; a group in it
#   is passed to the expression as $1. expr:
#   sum <col>                      the sum of <col> over the data rows (with its `else`)
#   sum <col> where <col2>=$1      the same, on rows where <col2> is the label's group
#   count <col>                    data rows where <col> is printed (or implied: an event's year)
# A summary page line printing two values labels the second `(2)` (G2's `Totale : 556 ...`).
#   ... unless <col>               rows where <col> is printed add nothing (as in columns.tsv)
#   sum <col> over subtotal        the printed subtotals of <col> added up (A1's EURO total:
#                                  the rows give 0,05 more, its subtotals' cent roundings;
#                                  each subtotal is checked against its rows)
# A summary line printed in the grid (T20 under its ten countries) is a printed figure,
# known by its label here, checked year column by year column (`lib/views._line_checks`):
#   sum rows of Y                  the facts, in the edition's year only: another year's
#                                  line may cover rows the table does not print (T20's
#   sum lines above                the summary lines printed above it
#   sum over subtotal              the subtotals above it (B4's total: its countries are rounded,
#                                  its areas are not, as A1's)
#   -                              none: kept, listed UNCHECKED (T20's `Altri`; the `di cui` and
#                                  `Totale ai Fini Doganali` lines of B4, D, G1, G2, I, F1, printed
#                                  in a box of their own: no column holds them)
# (maintainer, 2026-10-24: the ten countries are the facts, these lines are figures)
# A label under a heading carries it (`lib/extract.read_summary`): A1's per-currency totals are
# `Totali parziali per tipo valuta: USD`; the first, `1.552.753,27`, beside no currency, is the
# heading alone (the rows with no currency printed).

column3: sum ammontare where valuta=$1 unless val_fini_dog
sum ammontare where valuta= unless val_fini_dog
sum ammontare where valuta=$1 unless val_fini_dog
